text:
Maya (CSM): Quick sync 1 1 1 — WillowHealth wants to convert the upcoming 12-month renewal into a 9-month amendment and reduce seats from 20 -> 15 (true-up down). Procurement requires an updated PO + signed amendment before eSign. Who owns what?
Evan (WillowHealth): Yep. CFO pushed shorter term to align with budget cycles. Keep same per-seat rate. We'll provide a new PO referencing the original agreement id.
Tom (Finance): Ok on our side for net30 (instead of net45). PO must include billing entity name, vendor_code, and tax ID. Prefer PDF.
Maya (CSM): Draft PO example I can accept (paste into their system): ```{
  "po_number": "<PO#>",
  "billing_entity": "WillowHealth, Inc.",
  "vendor_code": "<vendor_code>",
  "amount": "<USD>",
  "term_months": "9",
  "tax_id": "<EIN>"
}``` Fill vendor_code/tax and attach.
Miguel (RevOps): WillowHealth vendor codes: 8491-US (US) or 8491-EU (EMEA). Which entity?
Evan (WillowHealth): US entity. We'll use 8491-US. PO team also requested the amendment be labeled Amendment v2 and reference contract 7492-RED.
Nina (Legal): I'll prepare a short Amendment v2 (term change + seat reduction + proration). Need counterparty legal contact to speed review. If they can turn redlines in 48hrs we can meet the billing cutoff.
Evan (WillowHealth): I'll loop in Jess Carter (jess.carter@willowhealth.com) now.
Diego (Onboarding): Heads-up: training roster changes. I'll remove the 5 seats from the next cohort and rebook remaining 15. Suggest week-of-21 for enablement. Also note entitlement update will cascade if we change seats mid-cycle.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Nina drafts amendment; Tom confirms net30 & invoice recipient; Evan sends PO w/ vendor_code + tax ID + billing entity; Diego holds week-of-21; I will create the DocuSign envelope once docs are attached.
Tom (Finance): Confirmed net30. Invoice recipient email? Also please include Willow's tax ID on PO so our billing automation maps correctly.
Evan (WillowHealth): Tax ID: 12-3456789. PO ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Nina (Legal): Draft uploaded to internal link: https://link.internal/amendment-v2-draft. Key clause: "Charges for removed seats will be prorated to the day of termination and credited on the next invoice." Flag if you want a specific proration formula included.
Maya (CSM): That wording looks fine. Evan ok with proration?
Evan (WillowHealth): Agreed.
integrations-bot: Notice: entitlement change queued (willow-entitlement-8491-US). Diego, please confirm target effective date to avoid training overlap.
Diego (Onboarding): I'll set effective date to the 1st of next month after PO processes, to avoid mid-session drops.
Maya (CSM): DocuSign plan: once we have PO PDF + signed amendment, I'll create envelope and tag Finance (Tom), Legal (Nina), and CSM. docusign-bot will post envelope id.
docusign-bot: Envelope created (placeholder)  EnvelopeID: 9f8e7d6c, status: awaiting signatures. Link: https://docusign.example/9f8e7d6c
Miguel (RevOps): Note for billing: SOW filename must be SOW_Willow_2026_Amendment_v2.pdf and include original contract id 7492-RED in metadata. This avoids manual reconciliation.
Maya (CSM): Recap \u2705: Evan to upload PO (8491-US, tax id, billing entity) by tomorrow EOD; Nina to finalize amendment and send to Jess; Tom confirmed net30; Diego to block week-of-21 and set entitlement change on the 1st of next month; I will kick off DocuSign when docs are attached.
Evan (WillowHealth): Will send PO tomorrow and loop Jess. Ping me if anything stalls. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): I'll also update the renewal opportunity in Gainsight with new term (9 months), seats (15), and expected execution date.
